simple.meaning: מַרְחֶשֶׁת (marchesheth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a stewpan.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 2:7. The surrounding context includes offering, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַרְחֶשֶׁת (H4802) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַרְחֶשֶׁת (marchesheth) / H4802 is traced through Leviticus 2:7, Leviticus 7:9 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H4802. marchesheth מַרְחֶ֫שֶׁת noun feminine stew-pan, sauce-pan (so Late Hebrew; see especially Levy NHWB iii. 69 b, and compare Late Hebrew רָחוֺשׁ Id ib. iv. 443 a ); — מ ׳מִנְחַת Lev 2:7 , בַּמּ ׳נַעֲשָׂה [ מִנְחָה ] כָּלֿ 7:9 .
